text: The town should host the autumn food festival. Evidence A highlights the vendor association's complete crowd management plan, which shows they are committed to ensuring a successful event. B provides the proposal of a night market format that has never been tried in the county, indicating a significant learning opportunity. C mentions projected stall fees covering costs with a comfortable surplus, which suggests potential financial sustainability. D presents the success of the spring fair in the same square for five years, reinforcing the idea that the town can replicate this concept and make adjustments as needed.
